findings.label: LLM timeout very short
findings.description: The 1-second timeout will frequently trigger regex fallback, which may mask LLM availability issues in production. Monitor fallback rates and consider increasing timeout to 2–3 seconds if LLM reliability improves.

findings.label: Color matching too broad
findings.description: Substring matching (e.g., 'bleu' in 'bleuet') may match unintended colors. Document that partial color matching is intentional and expected behavior, or tighten to whole-word-only matching if precision is critical.

findings.label: Soft preference vs hard filter gap
findings.description: The implementation hard-filters candidates by color (drops non-matching items) with a fallback to unfiltered list. The plan's language suggested soft preference boosts. The current approach is safer for small wardrobes but may surprise users expecting a ranking adjustment instead of filtering. No action needed (current behavior is correct), but document this for future maintainers.
